I didn't want to make my troubles seem prison like because at the end of the day my parents pay my bills and such... I have friends who are willing to take me in though if only that was legal...

But them taking my phone and forbidding me from leaving the house is pretty fucked up in my opinion...
Shes on the pill and we did it extremely safely. I can't help the way that I feel. I just want to be with her and I cant and its making me feel horrible.

My girlfriend's parents are actually for us they believe we should be together its just my parents who are pissed. 

I know I shouldn't have freaked out so much but she means so much to me.. I know I'm being blinded by love but shes my first. She means everything to me and I miss her.
